exclusions: Participant exclusions stated in the paper were already applied by the authors in the file (unfinished within 87 min, smartphone users, cheating / just clicking through, technical problems, >=10 estimates above the item weight). Not applied here: perfect-OJ and perfect-reproduction item cases (CJ/CR) and the outlier rule, which evaluation.evaluate applies itself to every session set; the CJ/CR rows are kept in the sessions (Dataset 2).
